items.title: Exact merged-main qualification
items.pass_condition: Exact merged source tree has complete strict qualification with zero fail/skip on MariaDB 10.6 and 10.11 and a bound receipt.

items.title: Inert staging update and host qualification
items.pass_condition: Exact release is deployed inertly, 31 migrations/no drift, host strict suite passes on qualification DB2, 16 role definitions exist, and no implicit v2 assignment/execution/schedule activation occurs.

items.title: Bounded real model evaluation
items.pass_condition: Approved 18-case bounded evaluation executes with genuine human grounding/usefulness assessments and accepted quality evidence.

items.title: MANUAL_MONITOR ROAD_TEST_001
items.pass_condition: Baseline/changed road test completes with 2 captures, bounded model attempts, exact request inspection, 2 actual human reviews and internal-only durable provenance.

items.title: Immediate stand-down and replay
items.pass_condition: All current/future execution authority is stood down, no recurrence remains, counters are zero and Monitor/M10 replay verifies.

items.title: P07 recurring-observation acceptance
items.pass_condition: One separately authorized bounded schedule captures/diffs only, queues changed work for a human, uses scheduler role v1, makes zero model calls unattended, and is stood down.

items.title: P09 desktop/mobile browser acceptance
items.pass_condition: Full desktop/mobile and negative HTTP/browser protocol passes on the exact deployed release with sanitized evidence.

items.title: Populated-history backup and empty-target restore
items.pass_condition: A new post-road-test encrypted backup restores to a new empty target with all governed history, 31 migration hashes, triggers and immutability intact.

items.title: Real key-rotation rehearsal
items.pass_condition: Disposable credential rewrap/recovery and wrong/unavailable-version refusals succeed with no provider call or retained plaintext.

items.title: P12 negative production-preflight acceptance
items.pass_condition: Current tree remains NOT_READY for production with exact target/release binding, fail-closed evidence selection, unknown/non-adopted customer audience and grants_go/customer_visibility false.

items.title: Evidence filing and closure
items.pass_condition: Sanitized reviewed evidence is filed per exact source/target/environment without relabelling failures or conflating source, qualification, deployment, activation or authority.
